title: Fused silica microspheres from fulgurites; Drumm inside a boat pit

tellings.quote: fused silica this is me down inside one of the boat pits adjacent to the great pyramid

plain: Tiny glass beads, which he links to fulgurites, the glass that forms when lightning strikes sand, turn up at the Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt, says Geoffrey Drumm, a researcher who has his own theory of what the pyramids were for. He shows Michels a photo of himself "down inside one of the boat pits adjacent to the great pyramid," the stone trenches beside the pyramid where ancient boats were buried. He offers the glass as a clue that great heat or electricity was at work there.
